blocks.evidence: The objective asks why food-making fails in darkness, so the missing condition must be linked causally to the outcome.
blocks.brief: Use the two-leaf anchor: both leaves have the same plant and soil, but only the lit leaf can make food. State that light supplies the required condition and that soil cannot explain the difference.

blocks.evidence: The anchor contains two legitimate experimental cases that differ on one condition and need inspection across the same dimensions.
blocks.brief: Compare lit and covered leaves across light received, same soil, and whether food can be made; make the controlled similarity visible without treating the misconception as a valid alternative.
